description: This file defines the PdfTransparencyGroupAttributes class, which represents a PDF transparency group XObject within the PdfSharp library, including its associated keys for its dictionary attributes, such as color space (CS), isolation flag (I), and knockout flag (K).

classes.name: PdfTransparencyGroupAttributes
classes.description: Represents a PDF transparency group XObject with specific attributes such as color space, isolation, and knockout settings.

methods.name: PdfTransparencyGroupAttributes
methods.description: Constructor initializing the transparency group attributes with a reference to the parent document.

classes.name: PdfTransparencyGroupAttributes.Keys
classes.description: Contains predefined keys for the transparency group attributes, such as CS (color space), I (isolation), and K (knockout), with associated metadata and documentation.

methods.name: Elements.SetName
methods.description: Sets a name (string) value for a dictionary element, used here to initialize the /S key to "/Transparency".
